title: Stateful Classify
text: Classify data using a trained deep learning recurrent neural network, 1 input, 3 outputs, {Sample time} sets Output sample period and optional time offset; {Network}, {File path} sets the mAT file containing trained recurrent neural network, {MATLAB function}, {Classification} sets the output predicted label with highest score, {Predictions} sets the output all scores and associated labels, {Input data formats} sets the input data format of dlnetwork character and {Class names workspace variable} sets the workspace variable containing class names of the network output. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: input
ports.summary: Sequence or time series data numeric array

ports.name: labels
ports.summary: Class labels for predicted scores matrix

params.name: Network
params.values: Source for trained recurrent neural network Network from MAT file (default) | Network from MATLAB function

params.name: File path
params.values: MAT file containing trained recurrent neural network untitled.mat (default) | MAT file name

params.name: MATLAB function
params.values: MATLAB function name untitled (default) | MATLAB function name

params.name: Sample time
params.values: Output sample period and optional time offset -1 (default) | scalar | vector

params.name: Classification
params.values: Output predicted label with highest score on (default) | off

params.name: Predictions
params.values: Output all scores and associated labels off (default) | on

params.name: Input data formats
params.values: Input data format of dlnetwork character vector | string

params.name: Class names workspace variable
params.values: Workspace variable containing class names of the network output classNames (default) | categorical vector variable | string array variable | cell array of character vectors variable name
